title: Chronic Fatigue / Epstein-Barr
excerpt: I immediately checked into the Institute, underweight and almost immobilized. On the 15th day I finally emerged from my suffering and started to know there was hope.
content:
I immediately checked into the Institute, underweight and almost immobilized. On the 15th day I finally emerged from my suffering and started to know there was hope. Through continuing the program and having emotional support and counseling, after a year and a half with unwavering progression, I finally gained the ability to remedy the stress in my life. Since I was a boy I have been a professional concert piano technician working at the most prestigious halls for some of the most particular artists on earth. Constant pressure and time constraints led me to make bad dietary choices, which further weakened my immune system beyond the pressure itself. My final liberation was to give this up and turn the keys over to my son. Now at my own speed, in my own time I rebuild pianos and every day thank Hippocrates and the Clements for supporting me in turning my life around. When you follow the program your body will heal itself and I strongly recommend that every person should embark on this effective voyage.
